acceptanceCriteria: readRefsContext returns ctx.Err() whenever the context is done and the read ended in an error (e.g. prefer ctx.Err() in the done case when r.err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil), keeping the V1-1155 no-leak guarantees.
TestCompileRefsReadHonoursContext passes with -count=20 (200 iterations each) and one mutation that removes the preference makes it fail within that run.
body: Observed 2026-10-15 on PR #920 CI (run 38761994872, job 116515913771, go-product-shard 7, linux): TestCompileRefsReadHonoursContext/V1-1155_cancellation_cleanup_survives_delayed_callback_dispatch failed with 'iteration 55 error=file already closed' (changes_test.go:388). PR #920 does not touch internal/upgradechanges. Cause (inferred from origin/main internal/upgradechanges/changes.go:648-701): on cancel, the AfterFunc callback closes the open descriptor; io.ReadAll then returns os.ErrClosed and the goroutine sends it on done. The final select has both done and ctx.Done ready and Go picks randomly, so the done case returns the close error instead of ctx.Err(). Expected: a cancelled read always returns context.Canceled. Actual: about 1 in a few hundred iterations returns 'file already closed'.
title: upgradechanges readRefsContext: cancellation can return 'file already closed' instead of context.Canceled (CI flake in TestCompileRefsReadHonoursContext)
